verses.original: וְהֶחֱזִיקוּ֩ שֶׁ֨בַע נָשִׁ֜ים בְּאִ֣ישׁ אֶחָ֗ד בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לַחְמֵ֣נוּ נֹאכֵ֔ל וְשִׂמְלָתֵ֖נוּ נִלְבָּ֑שׁ רַ֗ק יִקָּרֵ֤א שִׁמְךָ֙ עָלֵ֔ינוּ אֱסֹ֖ף חֶרְפָּתֵֽנוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·he·ḥĕ·zî·qū še·ḇa‘ nā·šîm bə·’îš ’e·ḥāḏ bay·yō·wm ha·hū lê·mōr laḥ·mê·nū nō·ḵêl wə·śim·lā·ṯê·nū nil·bāš raq yiq·qā·rê šim·ḵā ‘ā·lê·nū ’ĕ·sōp̄ ḥer·pā·ṯê·nū
verses.literal: In that day seven women will take hold of one man and say We will eat our own bread and provide our own clothes Just let us be called by your name . . . Take away our disgrace
verses.literalPt: E SETE mulheres naquele dia lançarão mão de um homem, dizendo: Nós comeremos do nosso pão, e nos vestiremos do que é nosso; tão-somente queremos ser chamadas pelo teu nome; tira o nosso opróbrio.

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶה֙ צֶ֣מַח יְהוָ֔ה לִצְבִ֖י וּלְכָב֑וֹד וּפְרִ֤י הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ לְגָא֣וֹן וּלְתִפְאֶ֔רֶת לִפְלֵיטַ֖ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū yih·yeh ṣe·maḥ Yah·weh liṣ·ḇî ū·lə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ ū·p̄ə·rî hā·’ā·reṣ lə·ḡā·’ō·wn ū·lə·ṯip̄·’e·reṯ lip̄·lê·ṭaṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: On that day the Branch of the LORD will be beautiful and glorious and the fruit of the land will be the pride and glory of Israel’s survivors
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia o renovo do SENHOR será cheio de beleza e de glória; e o fruto da terra excelente e formoso para os que escaparem de Israel.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ הַנִּשְׁאָ֣ר בְּצִיּ֗וֹן וְהַנּוֹתָר֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם קָד֖וֹשׁ יֵאָ֣מֶר ל֑וֹ כָּל־ הַכָּת֥וּב לַחַיִּ֖ים בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh han·niš·’ār bə·ṣî·yō·wn wə·han·nō·w·ṯār bî·rū·šā·lim qā·ḏō·wōš yê·’ā·mer lōw kāl- hak·kā·ṯūḇ la·ḥay·yîm bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Whoever remains in Zion and whoever is left in Jerusalem will be called holy all in Jerusalem who are recorded among the living
verses.literalPt: E será que aquele que for deixado em Sião, e ficar em Jerusalém, será chamado santo; todo aquele que estiver inscrito entre os viventes em Jerusalém;

verses.original: אִ֣ם׀ רָחַ֣ץ אֲדֹנָ֗י אֵ֚ת צֹאַ֣ת בְּנוֹת־ צִיּ֔וֹן וְאֶת־ דְּמֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם יָדִ֣יחַ מִקִּרְבָּ֑הּ בְּר֥וּחַ מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּבְר֥וּחַ בָּעֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’im rā·ḥaṣ ’ă·ḏō·nāy ’êṯ ṣō·’aṯ bə·nō·wṯ- ṣî·yō·wn wə·’eṯ- də·mê yə·rū·šā·lim yā·ḏî·aḥ miq·qir·bāh bə·rū·aḥ miš·pāṭ ū·ḇə·rū·aḥ bā·‘êr
verses.literal: when the Lord has washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion and cleansed the bloodstains from the heart of Jerusalem by a spirit of judgment and a spirit of fire
verses.literalPt: Quando o Senhor lavar a imundícia das filhas de Sião, e limpar o sangue de Jerusalém, do meio dela, com o espírito de justiça, e com o espírito de ardor.

verses.original: וּבָרָ֣א יְהוָ֡ה עַל֩ כָּל־ מְכ֨וֹן הַר־ צִיּ֜וֹן וְעַל־ מִקְרָאֶ֗הָ עָנָ֤ן׀ יוֹמָם֙ וְעָשָׁ֔ן וְנֹ֛גַהּ אֵ֥שׁ לֶהָבָ֖ה לָ֑יְלָה כִּ֥י עַל־ כָּל־ כָּב֖וֹד חֻפָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·rā Yah·weh ‘al kāl- mə·ḵō·wn har- ṣî·yō·wn wə·‘al- miq·rā·’e·hā ‘ā·nān yō·w·mām wə·‘ā·šān wə·nō·ḡah ’êš le·hā·ḇāh lā·yə·lāh kî ‘al- kāl- kā·ḇō·wḏ ḥup·pāh
verses.literal: Then the LORD will create over all of Mount Zion and over her assemblies a cloud of smoke by day and a glowing flame of fire by night For over all the glory there will be a canopy
verses.literalPt: E criará o SENHOR sobre todo o lugar do monte de Sião, e sobre as suas assembléias, uma nuvem de dia e uma fumaça, e um resplendor de fogo flamejante de noite; porque sobre toda a glória haverá proteção.

verses.original: וְסֻכָּ֛ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה לְצֵל־ יוֹמָ֖ם מֵחֹ֑רֶב וּלְמַחְסֶה֙ וּלְמִסְתּ֔וֹר מִזֶּ֖רֶם וּמִמָּטָֽר׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·suk·kāh tih·yeh lə·ṣêl- yō·w·mām mê·ḥō·reḇ ū·lə·maḥ·seh ū·lə·mis·tō·wr miz·ze·rem ū·mim·mā·ṭār
verses.literal: a shelter to give shade from the heat by day and a refuge and hiding place from the storm and the rain
verses.literalPt: E haverá um tabernáculo para sombra contra o calor do dia; e para refúgio e esconderijo contra a tempestade e a chuva.
